free_tier.stated: unverified: the pricing page states no free allowance, free credits or trial; it says 'No setup fees, no monthly minimums. Pay only for what you use.'
free_tier.notes: No free tier is published on the pricing page; model and compute rates apply from first use. The dashboard and signup are behind an API key and were not read as an account.

per_object_cap.stated: File uploads to a desktop are capped at 512 MB per file, transferred in 8 MB chunks; browser downloads are disabled.
per_object_cap.notes: The unit is a cloud computer, not an object store; the 512 MB figure is the only published per-file ceiling.

retention.stated: A computer is destroyed on termination or timeout with its filesystem, unless created with persistent: true; screenshot URLs are presigned and expire after roughly 7 days.
retention.notes: Persistent session state is retained until deleted.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing page lists token, CPU, memory and disk rates with no outbound transfer allowance or per-GB price; browser sessions support a residential proxy option, desktop sessions do not

interface_detail: Tasks, Responses API and Chat Completions over REST, a `lightcone` CLI and MCP server, a chat interface, cloud browsers driven through CDP/Playwright, and shell commands on a desktop session; the SDKs are Python (`tzafon`) and TypeScript (`@tzafon/lightcone`).
tooling: pip install tzafon, npm install @tzafon/lightcone, the lightcone CLI and MCP server; Playwright or Puppeteer can attach to browser sessions over CDP.
chaining: Runs Northstar computer-use tasks on a managed cloud desktop or browser and returns screenshots and HTML to the caller; hosted only, with an on-device Mac option named last in the platform docs and no own hardware required.

limits.value: CPU $0.38 per core-hour and memory $0.095 per GiB-hour, billed per second with a minimum of 0.125 cores per container
sessions terminate after inactivity_timeout_seconds of no activity; max_lifetime_seconds always applies regardless of activity
max 512 MB per file upload to a desktop session
10 failed authentication attempts in 10 minutes block the source IP; concurrent computers are plan-dependent and a 429 is returned at the limit

limits_note: Browser sessions allow at most 5 tabs, block downloads and Google domains, and cache html() for about 2 seconds; desktop session actions are serialized one at a time.
binding_note: No free allowance is published, so the meter starts at first use: a typical browser workload is about $0.075 an hour and a 10-20-step task lands between a few cents and about $0.50.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page presents an email field ('Your email address') and Continue with Google, GitHub and Apple; the quickstart says to sign up at lightcone.ai and copy an API key from the dashboard. No card, phone or ID is shown on signup, and the dashboard is behind a login wall, so any card requirement after signup is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Idle sessions are reaped and a hard lifetime cap applies regardless of activity; exceeding the concurrent computer limit returns 429; 10 failed authentication attempts in 10 minutes block the source IP. The API and SDK are in beta and behavior can change.
confidence_note: The rates, no-minimum statement, caps, timeouts and signup fields are quoted from first-party documentation read on 2026-11-24; the absence of a published free tier is on the pricing page, and the dashboard was a login wall.
